image_description: A Blenheim spaniel (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel) lying on green grass. The dog has a rich red-and-white parti-color coat with clearly defined red patches on a white ground. The head is domed with a short upturned nose and well-defined stop. Eyes are large, round, dark, and set wide apart. Ears are long, set low, and heavily feathered. The body is compact with a short back. The coat is long, silky, and straight with moderate feathering on ears, chest, legs, and tail. The tail is docked and carried level with the back. Legs are straight with fine bone and feathered hindquarters.
